build.title: Build
build.text: Raise houses, farms and workshops on the land you have cleared. Every building works for the kingdom, and grows with every level.

research.title: Research
research.text: The royal library is open. Spend Knowledge on technologies to unlock new buildings and make the kingdom thrive.

heroes.title: Heroes
heroes.text: Heroes lead your troops into battle. Call them at the Tavern, level them up and send them against the lairs around your kingdom.

bookSagas.title: The Sagas
bookSagas.text: A book found at the Tavern. Its technologies are about heroes, and the Tavern that hosts them.

relics.title: Relics
relics.text: Relics of the old kingdom lie broken across the land. Find their six pieces in lairs and the fog, restore them, and they work for you again.

bag.title: The Bag
bag.text: Chests, speed-ups and boosts you find are kept here until you use them. Open a chest when you need what is inside, or spend a speed-up on any timer.

world.title: The World
world.text: Beyond the mountains lie other kingdoms. From the Watchtower you can see the roads that lead to them.

bookAtlas.title: The Atlas
bookAtlas.text: A book found at the Watchtower. Its technologies sharpen sight, claim landmarks and reach for the world beyond.
